name: qupai-lab
description: Work with a QuPai lab from Claude Code: the lab's instruments as tools through QuPai, how to operate them safely, and its live page in the browser.

qupai_web.title: QuPai web address
qupai_web.description: Where you sign in to QuPai, without a trailing slash, for example https://qupai.quspect.com

gateway.title: QuPai gateway address
gateway.description: The part before /mcp/ in the address your lab's page in QuPai shows under Use in Claude or another agent, without a trailing slash

lab.title: Lab id
lab.description: Your lab's id in QuPai, for example csmot: the address ends in /mcp/lab-<lab id>
